about: Tracks every upstream Ice (jordanbaird/Ice) issue triaged for Icey. Scripts/build-site.py turns it into docs/upstream-issues.md and the website. Edit this file, never the generated page. status: fixed | partial | open | not-a-bug | feature. fixed_in: the Icey release tag that ships the fix, or null if it is not released yet. pr: the Icey pull request with the fix.

issues.title: Ice has noticeable energy impact during mouse movement
issues.headline: Ice uses energy every time you move the mouse
issues.symptom: Moving the mouse raised Ice's energy use in Activity Monitor, even with "Show on hover" turned off.
issues.fix: Icey only listens to mouse, scroll and drag events while a setting that needs them is on.

issues.title: Energy impact
issues.headline: Ice has a high energy impact in Activity Monitor
issues.symptom: Ice showed a high energy impact in Activity Monitor during normal use.
issues.fix: Icey stops listening to system-wide mouse events it doesn't need, so it stays near zero energy impact while idle.

issues.title: High CPU usage
issues.headline: Ice uses a lot of CPU after switching apps
issues.symptom: With menu bar appearance settings on, Ice's CPU use spiked after every app switch, because it polled the app menu every millisecond.
issues.fix: Icey polls with a back-off, and only for the split shape, which needs the app menu's width.

issues.title: memory leak in WindowServer caused by Ice?
issues.headline: WindowServer memory grows while Ice runs
issues.symptom: After the Ice Bar was shown once, Ice captured the menu bar every 5 seconds forever, which kept WindowServer busy and growing.
issues.fix: Icey only captures the menu bar while the Ice Bar is visible, and only captures the wallpaper for shapes that draw it.
issues.note: Icey takes far fewer captures. A WindowServer leak inside macOS itself can't be ruled out.

issues.title: high memory usage
issues.headline: Ice's memory use grows over time
issues.symptom: Ice's memory grew over long runtimes.
issues.fix: A screen capture leak is fixed, and the menu bar item image cache is pruned instead of growing without limit.

issues.title: Menu bar layout shown nothing on the sections
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout shows empty sections on macOS 26 Tahoe
issues.symptom: On macOS 26 Tahoe, the Menu Bar Layout pane showed empty sections or "Unable to display menu bar items".
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.

issues.title: Can't view the icons on Menu Bar Layout
issues.headline: Icons don't appear in Menu Bar Layout on macOS 26 Tahoe
issues.symptom: The Menu Bar Layout pane showed no icons, so items couldn't be rearranged.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.

issues.title: Can't see layout
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout is blank
issues.symptom: The Menu Bar Layout pane stayed blank.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.

issues.title: Icons in re-arrange menu in settings aren't visible
issues.headline: Icons in the settings rearrange view aren't visible
issues.symptom: The icons in the Menu Bar Layout settings didn't show, so nothing could be rearranged.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.

issues.title: I can't edit my layout, because it's all blank
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout is blank and can't be edited
issues.symptom: The Menu Bar Layout pane was blank, so the layout couldn't be edited.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.

issues.title: Settings Menu: Menu Bar Layout Icons Do Not Appear
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout icons don't appear in settings
issues.symptom: No icons appeared in the Menu Bar Layout pane.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably, so the layout shows your items.

issues.title: Starts but nothing much more
issues.headline: Ice starts but its layout, Ice Bar and search show nothing
issues.symptom: Ice launched, but its menu bar layout, Ice Bar and search showed no items.
issues.fix: Icey is built on Ice's Tahoe rewrite, and its helper for identifying menu bar items now connects reliably.

issues.title: app crash after click in menubar
issues.headline: Ice crashes when you click the menu bar
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, Ice could crash when you clicked the menu bar.
issues.fix: The code that crashed is gone, and similar conversions elsewhere no longer crash on unexpected values.

issues.title: crashes whenever I use the trigger button in the menu bar
issues.headline: Ice crashes when you click its menu bar icon
issues.symptom: On macOS 26, clicking Ice's own menu bar icon to show hidden items crashed the app.
issues.fix: The code that crashed is gone, and similar conversions elsewhere no longer crash on unexpected values.

issues.title: Crash when enabling "Use Ice Bar" with Dynamic location
issues.headline: Ice crashes when you enable the Ice Bar with the Dynamic location
issues.symptom: Turning on "Use Ice Bar" with the Dynamic location crashed Ice.
issues.fix: The code that crashed is gone, and similar conversions elsewhere no longer crash on unexpected values.

issues.title: (untitled report)
issues.headline: Ice crashes at launch with the Ice Bar on macOS 26.4
issues.symptom: With the Ice Bar enabled, Ice 0.11.12 crashed at launch or while running on macOS 26.4, on a main-thread check while reading the menu bar's window.
issues.fix: Icey doesn't have the Ice 0.11.12 code that crashed.

issues.title: update dialog keeps open and cannot be closed after launch
issues.headline: The update dialog stays open and can't be closed
issues.symptom: The "Check for updates automatically?" dialog opened on launch and couldn't be closed.
issues.fix: The dialog now comes to the front, accepts input, and stays answered.

issues.title: Check for automatic updates keeps appearing when clicking
issues.headline: The automatic updates prompt keeps coming back
issues.symptom: The "Check for updates automatically?" prompt came back again and again.
issues.fix: The dialog now comes to the front, accepts input, and stays answered.

issues.title: Check for updates automatically dialog box doesnt accept input
issues.headline: The automatic updates dialog doesn't accept clicks
issues.symptom: The "Check for updates automatically?" dialog ignored clicks.
issues.fix: The dialog now comes to the front, accepts input, and stays answered.

issues.title: Update window won't shut down after clicking on update option
issues.headline: The update window won't close after you choose an option
issues.symptom: After choosing an update option, the update window stayed open.
issues.fix: The dialog now comes to the front, accepts input, and stays answered.

issues.title: (untitled report)
issues.headline: The update dialog doesn't let you click its options
issues.symptom: On macOS 26.4.1, none of the options in the update dialog could be clicked.
issues.fix: The dialog now comes to the front, accepts input, and stays answered.

issues.title: (untitled report)
issues.headline: The "Check for updates automatically" pop-up won't close
issues.symptom: Right after opening Ice on macOS 26.3.1, the "Check for updates automatically" pop-up stayed open after either option was chosen.
issues.fix: The dialog now comes to the front, accepts input, and stays answered.

issues.title: Ice Bar leaves a ghost/visual artifact on the primary display when a video enters fullscreen on a secondary display
issues.headline: The Ice Bar leaves an empty ghost bar when a video goes fullscreen on another display
issues.symptom: If a space or display changed while the Ice Bar was opening, for example a video entering fullscreen on another display, an empty bar stayed on screen.
issues.fix: The Ice Bar now stays closed when the space or display changes while it opens.

issues.title: Split menu bar does not function like expected in full screen
issues.headline: The split menu bar shape breaks in fullscreen
issues.symptom: The menu bar appearance used the fullscreen state of whichever display had focus, so the split shape broke in fullscreen.
issues.fix: Each display now uses its own fullscreen state.

issues.title: Ice Bar fullscreen expansion behaves differently depending on which display contains the active window
issues.headline: The Ice Bar behaves differently in fullscreen depending on the active display
issues.symptom: In fullscreen, the Ice Bar expanded differently depending on which display had the active window.
issues.fix: Each display now uses its own fullscreen state.

issues.title: Ice stuck / menu bar stays hidden after form dropdown hang
issues.headline: Ice gets stuck and the menu bar stays hidden when an app hangs
issues.symptom: When an app stopped responding, Ice could get stuck waiting for it, and the menu bar stayed hidden.
issues.fix: Accessibility calls now give up after 1 second, and stuck item moves and clicks time out and retry.

issues.title: With an app item among the system items, clicking the battery opens that app and Wi-Fi does not open
issues.headline: On macOS 27, clicking the battery opens another app and Wi-Fi doesn't open
issues.symptom: On macOS 27, with an app's item placed among the system items, clicking the battery opened that app, and Wi-Fi didn't open.
issues.fix: Each click now reaches the item you clicked.

issues.title: Ice in menu bar not working anymore (MacOS Golden Gate 27)
issues.headline: Ice stops hiding menu bar items on macOS 27
issues.symptom: On macOS 27, Ice could no longer hide items, and Screen Mirroring disappeared from the menu bar.
issues.fix: Icey includes early macOS 27 support: hiding, the Ice Bar and the layout editor work again, and Screen Mirroring stays.
issues.note: Early macOS 27 support, built from community work for Ice. Please report anything that doesn't work.

issues.title: An app launched while concealed gets a squashed (3 pt) menu bar item that never recovers
issues.headline: On macOS 27, an app launched while items are hidden gets a squashed menu bar item
issues.symptom: On macOS 27, an app that launched while items were hidden got a 3-point-wide menu bar item that never recovered.
issues.fix: Icey's macOS 27 support sorts items into the right section when an app launches or quits.

issues.title: What got Ice working with PR #995, plus two things to look into
issues.headline: Getting Ice working on macOS 27
issues.symptom: Ice didn't work on macOS 27 without the unmerged community pull request jordanbaird/Ice#995 and further fixes.
issues.fix: Icey includes jordanbaird/Ice#995 and the follow-up fixes this issue describes.

issues.title: always loading meum bar items
issues.headline: Menu bar items keep loading forever on macOS 27
issues.symptom: On macOS 27, the menu bar items list kept loading and never showed anything.
issues.fix: Icey includes early macOS 27 support, so the layout editor loads your items.

issues.title: (untitled report)
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout stuck on "Loading menu bar items" on macOS 27.2 beta
issues.symptom: On macOS 27.2 beta 3, the Menu Bar Layout pane showed "Loading menu bar items..." with a spinner forever.
issues.fix: Icey includes early macOS 27 support, so the layout editor loads your items on macOS 27.
issues.note: Early macOS 27 support. macOS 27.2 betas are untested.

issues.title: Not functioning since MacOS 27 update on my Macbook pro M3 pro
issues.headline: Ice stops working after updating to macOS 27
issues.symptom: After updating to macOS 27, Ice stopped working.
issues.fix: Icey includes early macOS 27 support: hiding, the Ice Bar and the layout editor work again.

issues.title: Updated to MacOS 27.0.1 and cannot customize Menu Bar Layout on Ice
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout can't be customized on macOS 27.0.1
issues.symptom: On macOS 27.0.1, the Menu Bar Layout couldn't be customized.
issues.fix: Icey includes early macOS 27 support, so the layout editor works again.

issues.title: Ice not working properly on macOS 27 Golden Gate
issues.headline: Ice doesn't work properly on macOS 27
issues.symptom: On macOS 27, hiding items, the Ice Bar and the layout editor didn't work.
issues.fix: Icey includes early macOS 27 support: hiding, the Ice Bar and the layout editor work again.

issues.title: unavailable under MacOS27
issues.headline: Ice is unusable on macOS 27
issues.symptom: Ice was unusable on macOS 27.
issues.fix: Icey includes early macOS 27 support: hiding, the Ice Bar and the layout editor work again.

issues.title: MacOS 27 Update
issues.headline: Ice breaks after the macOS 27 update
issues.symptom: Ice broke after the macOS 27 update.
issues.fix: Icey includes early macOS 27 support: hiding, the Ice Bar and the layout editor work again.

issues.title: Not automatically hiding in MacOS 27
issues.headline: Menu bar items don't hide automatically on macOS 27
issues.symptom: On macOS 27, items didn't hide again automatically.
issues.fix: Icey includes early macOS 27 support for hiding and showing items.
issues.note: Early macOS 27 support. Auto-rehide is untested on macOS 27.

issues.title: Menubar layout broken/spinning in MacOS 27 Public Beta
issues.headline: Menu Bar Layout keeps spinning on the macOS 27 beta
issues.symptom: On the macOS 27 public beta, the Menu Bar Layout pane showed a spinner forever.
issues.fix: Icey includes early macOS 27 support, so the layout editor loads your items.

issues.title: Ice Bar auto-hides before cursor reaches it (latest beta)
issues.headline: The Ice Bar closes before the pointer reaches it
issues.symptom: With timed or hover auto-rehide, the Ice Bar could close while you moved the pointer down to it.
issues.fix: The Ice Bar's area now counts as inside the menu bar, including during the moment before it appears.

issues.title: Ligthing error when enabeling split shape in menu bar appearance
issues.headline: The split menu bar shape looks brighter than the rest of the menu bar
issues.symptom: With the split shape, the area around the shape looked brighter than the rest of the menu bar.
issues.fix: Icey now captures the wallpaper with the system's dimming layer, so the colors match.

issues.title: Ice icon dissappeared
issues.headline: The Ice icon disappears and the layout pane keeps loading
issues.symptom: When Ice's divider was missing from the menu bar, for example after turning Ice off in System Settings > Menu Bar, the icon was gone and the Menu Bar Layout pane loaded forever.
issues.fix: The layout pane now says what's wrong and how to get the icon back.

issues.title: Unable to proceed past permissions request.
issues.headline: Ice keeps asking for a permission that is already enabled
issues.symptom: System Settings showed Accessibility or Screen Recording as enabled, but Ice still asked for it.
issues.fix: Icey explains what to do: remove the app from the list in System Settings with the minus button, then add it again. Screen Recording granted while Icey runs now takes effect without a relaunch.

issues.title: Menu bar scaling and layout issues on external/built-in displays
issues.headline: Menu bar icons are scaled wrong on external displays
issues.symptom: With an external and a built-in display, item images were shown at the wrong scale.
issues.fix: Item images now use the scale of the display they were captured on.
issues.note: Not yet confirmed on a two-display setup.

issues.title: Ice Bar icons shrink drastically when expanded on an external display
issues.headline: Ice Bar icons shrink on an external display
issues.symptom: On an external display, the Ice Bar's icons were drawn much smaller than they should be.
issues.fix: Item images now take their scale from the capture itself.
issues.note: Not yet confirmed on a two-display setup.

issues.title: Scale error and auto-deploying
issues.headline: Ice Bar icons are scaled wrong on another display
issues.symptom: Ice Bar icons were scaled wrong when shown on another display.
issues.fix: Item images now take their scale from the capture itself.
issues.note: Not yet confirmed on a two-display setup.

issues.title: iPad appearance tint shows on main monitor when the iPad is used as an extended display
issues.headline: The menu bar tint shows on the wrong display with an iPad as a second screen
issues.symptom: With an iPad used as an extended display (Sidecar), a tint strip from the menu bar appearance showed on the main display.
issues.fix: An appearance overlay that ends up on another display now hides itself.
issues.note: Not yet confirmed with an iPad.

issues.title: Ice appears to have caused system-wide freeze & kernel panic after ~33 hours of uptime
issues.headline: System freeze after long uptime with Ice running
issues.symptom: A Mac froze after about 33 hours of uptime with Ice running. Ice retried moving an item every 3 seconds forever when it couldn't put it back.
issues.fix: The crashing code from Ice 0.11.12 is gone. Retries now back off and stop after five rounds, and Icey recovers when its divider reappears.
issues.note: The freeze itself hasn't been reproduced.

issues.title: MacOS Tahoe 26.5 update broke hidden elements in ice layout
issues.headline: Hidden items are shown as always-hidden after macOS Tahoe 26.5
issues.symptom: After updating to macOS 26.5, items in the hidden section showed up in the wrong section of the layout.
issues.fix: Needs a reproduction in Icey.

issues.title: When icon for Intego One is moved from hidden to visible bar in settings, the icon disappears
issues.headline: An app's icon disappears when moved from hidden to visible
issues.symptom: Moving Intego One's icon from the hidden to the visible section made it disappear.
issues.fix: Needs a reproduction in Icey.

issues.title: Removed icon from tray and can't get it back
issues.headline: Ice's icon was removed from the menu bar and won't come back
issues.symptom: Ice's own icon was removed from the menu bar.
issues.fix: Turn the icon back on in System Settings > Menu Bar.

issues.title: Nothing happens when I try to run Ice
issues.headline: Nothing happens when you open Ice
issues.symptom: Ice seemed not to start.
issues.fix: Ice is running but its icon has no room in the menu bar, for example next to the notch. It shows up on a wider display. Hide or remove other items, or reduce item spacing.

issues.title: App opens in dock when expanding the bar
issues.headline: A Dock icon appears when you show hidden items
issues.symptom: Showing hidden items made the app appear in the Dock for a moment.
issues.fix: This is how "Hide application menus" works: it makes the app active for a moment. Turn that setting off, or use the Ice Bar.

issues.title: Orphaned application menu-bar windows stuck at CGWindow layer 101, invisible to accessibility
issues.headline: Orphaned menu bar windows stuck at layer 101
issues.symptom: Invisible menu bar windows stayed on screen.
issues.fix: Not caused by Ice: the reporter saw it with the setting off and after removing Ice.

issues.title: OneDrive icons
issues.headline: OneDrive icons move to the always-hidden section
issues.symptom: OneDrive's icons ended up in the always-hidden section.
issues.fix: Some apps don't remember their item positions, so macOS places them in the always-hidden section. See the frequent issues page.

issues.title: Unsplash client crashes shortly after being hidden by ICE
issues.headline: An app crashes after its menu bar item is hidden
issues.symptom: The Unsplash app crashed shortly after its item was hidden.
issues.fix: The other app crashes when its item is off screen. See the frequent issues page.

issues.title: How to uninstall?
issues.headline: How to uninstall Ice
issues.symptom: How to quit and uninstall the app.
issues.fix: See the frequent issues page.

issues.title: Is the project still alive?
issues.headline: Is the Ice project still alive?
issues.symptom: Users asked whether Ice is still maintained.
issues.fix: Ice is no longer maintained. Icey continues it.

issues.title: This project is no longer maintained by the original author
issues.headline: Is Ice still maintained?
issues.symptom: Users asked whether Ice is still maintained.
issues.fix: Ice is no longer maintained. Icey continues it.

issues.title: IS THIS PROJECT ABANDONED?
issues.headline: Is Ice abandoned?
issues.symptom: Users asked whether Ice is still maintained.
issues.fix: Ice is no longer maintained. Icey continues it.

issues.title: Some Golden Gate Clarity
issues.headline: Will Ice support macOS 27?
issues.symptom: Users asked whether Ice is still maintained.
issues.fix: Ice is no longer maintained. Icey continues it, with early macOS 27 support.

issues.title: Unofficial macOS 26-compatible build of Ice
issues.headline: Unofficial macOS 26 build of Ice
issues.symptom: An announcement for another unofficial build.
issues.fix: Not a bug.

issues.title: Website SSL cert expired
issues.headline: Ice's website certificate expired
issues.symptom: Upstream's website showed a certificate error.
issues.fix: This is about upstream's website, not the app.

issues.title: Option that lets you choose location of new items
issues.headline: Choose which section new menu bar items appear in
issues.symptom: A request for a setting that decides where new menu bar items go.
issues.fix: Not started. Needs a way to recognize new items and move them automatically. Pull requests welcome.

issues.title: No dock icon
issues.headline: Keep the app out of the Dock
issues.symptom: A request to never show a Dock icon.
issues.fix: Not started. Needs an option to keep Icey out of the Dock while Settings is open. Pull requests welcome.

upstream_prs.summary: restore hiding, the Ice Bar and the layout editor on macOS 27.
follow-ups for the remaining macOS 27 gaps.
pick up permissions granted after launch (adapted).
